paragraphs.source_en: Thus the theory could not predict what should emerge from the big bang. Some saw this as an indication of Cod's freedom to start the universe off in any way God wanted, but others (including myself) felt that the beginning of the universe should be governed by the same laws that held at other times. We have made some progress toward this goal, as will be described in Chapter 3, but we don't yet have a complete understanding of the origin of the universe.
